L10: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
L10: Mode fault / collision detection.
L10: All clock polarity/phase combinations.
L10: MSB-first vs LSB-first byte ordering.
L10: Bidirectional mode (single data pin).
L10: Receive overrun (flag-serviced-too-late).
L10: Baud rate divisor sweep.
L10: Wait/Stop mode behavior.
L16: Hardware shall return 0 for all bits and registers marked as Reserved.
L16: Software shall write all reserved bits with the value 0.
L16: Register accesses shall have a maximum size of 64 bits.
L16: 64-bit accesses shall not cross an 8-byte alignment boundary.
L16: Locked accesses are not supported.
L16: AHCI memory-mapped registers shall reside in non-cacheable memory.
L16: If CAP.SAM=0, GHC.AE is RW with reset 0; if CAP.SAM=1, GHC.AE is RO 1.
L16: Software shall set GHC.AE=1 before other AHCI register access (CAP.SAM=0).
L16: Clearing GHC.AE requires writing 0x00000000 to GHC.
L16: PI shall have at least one bit set; popcount(PI) ≤ CAP.NP+1.
L16: Each port implements PxCLB / PxCLBU / PxFB / PxFBU / PxIS / PxIE / PxCMD / PxTFD / PxSIG / PxSSTS / PxSCTL / PxSERR / Px
L16: AHCI 1.3.1 HBAs shall implement PxDEVSLP when CAP2.SDS=1.
L16: Command List shall be 1 KB aligned.
L16: Received FIS Structure shall be 256 B aligned (or 4 KB when PxFBS.EN=1).
L16: Command Header shall be 32 B; up to 32 per port.
L16: Command Table shall be 128 B aligned.
L16: CFL shall be 2..16 Dwords.
L16: PRD entries are 16 B; up to 65,535 per Command Table; DBA word-aligned; DBC even byte count.
L16: FIS payload protected by 32-bit CRC, polynomial 0x04C11DB7.
L16: VS for 1.3.1 reads 0x00010301.
L16: Class Code is 0x010601.
L16: PxCMD.ST set only after PxCMD.FRE=1.
L16: Clear PxCMD.ST and wait PxCMD.CR=0 before clearing PxCMD.FRE.
L16: Do not modify PxCLB/PxCLBU/PxFB/PxFBU while ST=1 or FRE=1.
L16: Software-initiated port reset holds PxSCTL.DET=1 for at least 1 ms.
L16: PxCMD.ICC=8h only when CAP2.SDS=1 + PxDEVSLP.DSP=1.
